{{nihongo|'''Sasaki Shrine'''|沙沙貴神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Ōmi Province]].

'''Sasaki Shrine''' (ささきじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in Jōrakuji, Azuchi, Ōmihachiman, Shiga Prefecture. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}; former rank was {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Prefectural Shrine}}.

=== Overview ===
It enshrines five deities in four seats including {{ill|Sukunabikona|ca|Sukunabikona|fr|Sukunabikona|it|Sukuna-hikona|ja|スクナビコナ|ko|스쿠나비코나|mni|ꯁꯨꯀꯨꯅꯕꯤꯀꯣꯅ|pl|Sukunabikona|pt|Sukunahikona|simple|Sukunabikona|sv|Suku-Na-Bikona|zh|少彥名|qid=Q3275687|lt=Sukunahikona-no-Mikoto}}, collectively called “Sasaki Daimyōjin.” It is the clan shrine of the {{ill|Omi Genji|ja|近江源氏|qid=Q11638504}} and stands at the birthplace of the Sasaki surname.

=== History ===
Tradition says Sukunahikona crossed the sea in a bean-pod boat and landed here in the age of the gods. From this the area came to be called “Sasaki,” and enshrining Sukunahikona there became the shrine’s origin.

In the Heian period it was a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} in Gamō District, Ōmi Province.

When {{ill|Sasaki Nariyori|fr|Sasaki Nariyori|ja|源成頼|pt|Minamoto no Nariyori|qid=Q11564102}} of the {{ill|Uda Genji|de|Uda Genji|fa|اودا گنجی|fr|Uda Genji|it|Uda Genji|ja|宇多源氏|ko|우다 겐지|min|Uda Genji|pt|Uda Genji|vi|Uda Genji|zh|宇多源氏|qid=Q4846201}} settled here, his grandson {{ill|Sasaki Tsunekata|ja|佐々木経方|pt|Sasaki Tsunekata|qid=Q11382364}} took the Sasaki name. As fusion advanced with local Sasaki clan descendants, they newly enshrined Prince Atsumi and Emperor Uda and made this their clan shrine.

In the Sengoku period, the ruling Rokkaku line was expelled by {{ill|Oda Nobunaga|af|Oda Nobunaga|ar|أودا نوبوناغا|arz|اودا نوبوناجا|ast|Oda Nobunaga|az|Oda Nobunaqa|ban|Oda Nobunaga|bcl|Oda Nobunaga|be|Ода Набунага|bg|Ода Нобунага|bs|Oda Nobunaga|ca|Oda Nobunaga|cdo|Cék-dièng Séng-diòng|ckb|ئۆدا نۆبوناگا|cs|Nobunaga Oda|da|Oda Nobunaga|de|Oda Nobunaga|el|Όντα Νομπουνάγκα|eo|Oda Nobunaga|es|Oda Nobunaga|et|Oda Nobunaga|eu|Oda Nobunaga|fa|اودا نوبوناگا|fi|Oda Nobunaga|fr|Oda Nobunaga|gl|Oda Nobunaga|glk|اؤدا نؤبۊناگا|hak|Oda Nobunaga|he|אודה נובונאגה|hr|Oda Nobunaga|hu|Oda Nobunaga|id|Oda Nobunaga|is|Oda Nobunaga|it|Oda Nobunaga|ja|織田信長|ka|ოდა ნობუნაგა|kk|Ода Нобунага|ko|오다 노부나가|kw|Oda Nobunaga|la|Nobunanga|lt|Oda Nobunaga|lv|Oda Nobunaga|mg|Oda Nobunaga|mn|Ода Нобүнага|ms|Oda Nobunaga|nl|Oda Nobunaga|no|Oda Nobunaga|oc|Oda Nobunaga|pam|Nobunaga Oda|pl|Nobunaga Oda|pt|Oda Nobunaga|ro|Nobunaga Oda|ru|Ода Нобунага|sc|Oda Nobunaga|sh|Nobunaga Oda|simple|Oda Nobunaga|sk|Nobunaga Oda|sq|Oda Nobunaga|sr|Ода Нобунага|su|Oda Nobunaga|sv|Oda Nobunaga|tg|Ода Набунага|th|โอดะ โนบูนางะ|tl|Oda Nobunaga|tr|Oda Nobunaga|uk|Ода Нобунаґа|ur|اودا نوبوناگا|vi|Oda Nobunaga|war|Oda Nobunaga|wuu|织田信长|xmf|ოდა ნობუნაგა|zh|織田信長|zh_classical|織田信長|zh_min_nan|Oda Nobunaga|zh_yue|織田信長|zu|Oda Nobunaga|qid=Q171411}}. Later {{ill|Azuchi Castle|ar|قلعة أزوتشي|az|Azuçi qəsri|ca|Castell d'Azuchi|cs|Azuči (hrad)|de|Burg Azuchi|es|Castillo Azuchi|fa|قلعه آزوچی|fi|Azuchin linna|fr|Château d'Azuchi|hu|Azucsi várkastély|hy|Ազուչիի դղյակ|id|Istana Azuchi|it|Castello di Azuchi|ja|安土城|jv|Istana Azuchi|ka|აძუჩის ციხესიმაგრე|ko|아즈치성|ml|അസുച്ചി കാസ്റ്റിൽ|nl|Kasteel Azuchi|pl|Zamek Azuchi|pt|Castelo de Azuchi|ru|Замок Адзути|th|ปราสาทอาซูจิ|tr|Azuchi Kalesi|uk|Замок Адзуті|vi|Thành Azuchi|zh|安土城|qid=Q786888}} was built nearby, but the shrine survived.

In the Tenpō era, fire destroyed buildings. In {{ill|1848|ab|1848|af|1848|als|1848|am|1848 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1848|ar|1848|ary|1848|arz|1848|ast|1848|avk|1848|az|1848|azb|۱۸۴۸ (میلادی)|ba|1848 йыл|ban|1848|bar|1848|bcl|1848|be|1848|be_x_old|1848|bg|1848|bn|১৮৪৮|bpy|মারি ১৮৪৮|br|1848|bs|1848.|ca|1848|cdo|1848 nièng|ce|1848 шо|ceb|1848|ckb|١٨٤٨|crh|1848|cs|1848|csb|1848|cv|1848|cy|1848|da|1848|de|1848|diq|1848|el|1848|eml|1848|eo|1848|es|1848|et|1848|eu|1848|fa|۱۸۴۸|fi|1848|fiu_vro|1848|fo|1848|fr|1848|frp|1848|frr|1848|fur|1848|fy|1848|ga|1848|gan|1848年|gcr|1848|gd|1848|gl|1848|gv|1848|he|1848|hi|१८४८|hif|1848|hr|1848.|hsb|1848|ht|1848 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1848|hy|1848|hyw|1848 թուական|ia|1848|id|1848|ilo|1848|io|1848|is|1848|it|1848|ja|1848年|jbo|1848moi|jv|1848|ka|1848|kaa|1848|kk|1848 жыл|kn|೧೮೪೮|ko|1848년|krc|1848 джыл|ksh|Joohr 1848|ku|1848|kv|1848-ӧд во|la|1848|lb|1848|lez|1848 йис|li|1848|lij|1848|lmo|1848|lt|1848 m.|lv|1848. gads|mai|१८४८|map_bms|1848|mdf|1848|mg|1848|mhr|1848|mi|1848|min|1848|mk|1848|ml|1848|mn|1848 он|mr|इ.स. १८४८|mrj|1848 и|ms|1848|my|၁၈၄၈|myv|1848 ие|mzn|۱۸۴۸|nah|1848|nap|1848|nds|1848|new|ई सं १८४८|nl|1848|nn|1848|no|1848|nrm|1848|nso|1848|oc|1848|olo|1848|or|୧୮୪୮|os|1848-æм аз|pa|1848|pap|1848|pl|1848|pnb|1848|pt|1848|qu|1848|rm|1848|ro|1848|ru|1848 год|rue|1848|sa|१८४८|sah|1848|sc|1848|scn|1848|sd|1848ع|se|1848|sh|1848.|shn|1848|simple|1848|sk|1848|sl|1848|smn|1848|sq|1848|sr|1848|stq|1848|su|1848|sv|1848|sw|1848|szl|1848|ta|1848|te|1848|tg|Соли 1848|th|พ.ศ. 2391|tk|1848|tl|1848|tly|1848|tr|1848|tt|1848 ел|uk|1848|ur|1848ء|uz|1848|vec|1848|vi|1848|vls|1848|vo|1848|wa|1848|war|1848|wuu|1848年|xmf|1848|yi|1848|za|1848 nienz|zea|1848|zh|1848年|zh_min_nan|1848 nî|zh_yue|1848年|qid=Q7647}} (Kōka 5), Marugame lord {{ill|Kyōgoku Takaakira|ja|京極高朗|qid=Q11374472}} rebuilt the main sanctuary, gonden, worship hall, and rōmon in Heian/Kamakura style. These are now Shiga-designated tangible cultural properties.

In September 2018, Typhoon 21 damaged the main sanctuary etc.; repairs were completed in May 2020<ref name=kyoto>[https://www.kyoto-np.co.jp/articles/-/236168 Kyoto Shimbun, May 7, 2020]</ref>.
